callback_behavior_static.caller_region: apparent function body 02C04730..02C04D90; preceding 02C04720 is a near-jump shim; no .pdata entry was included, so the function boundary is strongly suggested by code shape but not independently unwind-table validated
observed_patterns: At 02C04977, the vcall uses RCX=[RBX+0x48], RDX=[RCX], then [RDX+0x10]; its result is compared with 1.
If result==1, the linked record is unlinked, the count at [RSI+0x118] is decremented, and a 0x58-byte record is freed; otherwise elapsed time is added to [RBX+0x50].
A second vcall at 02C04ACA uses RCX=[RDI+0x40] and the same vtable slot; its result similarly controls removal/update in a ring-buffer-like structure.
callback_behavior_static.inference: This code behaves like callback-driven timed/queue maintenance. The result==1 completion/removal interpretation is plausible from control flow, but class, callback, and subsystem names remain unknown.
